At Donna, we're introducing new benefits and meaningful opportunities designed to support your development, provide stability, and set you up for long-term success. About Donna Donna provides premium remote talent to business leaders across North America. We are a high-performance culture defined by trust, care, and exceptional service. Learn more about us at hiredonna.com. The Role There is no one typical Executive Assistant role. Every business and every client is a little different. You'll provide day-to-day executive support, manage calendars and inboxes, assist with personal / admin tasks, and proactively anticipate client needs. Depending on your strengths, you may also be matched to a similar role (e.g., customer support). Full training and support are provided. What You'll Do Manage calendars, meetings, and travel Organize inboxes and draft communications Handle personal tasks and errands Stay highly responsive during work hours Build trust through proactive, reliable support Create meaningful "moments of joy" for your client Requirements 2+ years of professional experience as an Executive Assistant or similar support role Excellent spoken and written English (confident, nuanced communication) Proactive, reliable, detail-oriented, and focused Full-time availability, including during the 3 - 4 week paid training starting the second week of July 2026 Able to work overnight PH shifts (EST / PST), Monday to Friday Stable computer + internet connection with backup Filipino citizen based in the Philippines Preferred Experience with North American or global companies EA background (advantage but not required) Benefits ₱55,000 / month, paid semi-monthly Fully remote, full-time Holistic paid training Career growth and development Paid time off Upcoming benefits: HMO, SSS, Pag-IBIG, PhilHealth, performance bonuses, prorated 13th-month pay Hiring Process We recommend reviewing https://resources.hiredonna.com/meet-donna to understand our culture, hiring journey, and training program. Our straightforward process: Application → One-way video interview → Recruiter interview → Final interview. paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Executive Assistant position at donna, where I believe my strong organizational skills and legal background can contribute to your team's success.

With extensive experience in event coordination and contract management, I have successfully organized and managed over 14 community events with an average of 25 international participants each. My ability to handle logistics, stakeholder liaison, and communication will be invaluable in supporting the Executive Assistants at donna.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), demonstrating my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I work comfortably and independently in both English and Finnish, and I approach both complex legal analysis and routine administrative tasks with the same attention to detail and proactive attitude.

I am particularly drawn to donna's mission of providing premium remote talent to business leaders across North America. The opportunity to work within a high-performance culture defined by trust, care, and exceptional service aligns perfectly with my own values and professional goals.
Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
